name: Nissan Skyline GT-R (BCNR33, 1995-1998: twin-turbo 2.6 L straight six, variable four-wheel drive, 2+2 coupe). In the game: NISSINO N33 GT-X
model: render/car/n33 (cage.ts: the hand-placed control cage, the frame 차체 B; frame.ts: its stretch; render/car/p959/shell.ts shellFrom finishes it)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4675); y half-width from the centre line; z from the ground
approximate: values marked [~] are read loosely or from general sources outside the repository; R4 checks them against the car's figures

tolerance.overall: makers' figures: exact (length 4675, width 1780, height 1360, wheelbase 2720); the model's roof is the blueprint's 1364
tolerance.tracks: [~] 1480 front, 1490 rear (the usual quoted figures; not on the drawings)
tolerance.overhangs: +-15: 950 front, 1005 rear (the blueprint's axles at 183.5 and 678 px; its nose and tail 7 and 26 mm short of the maker's length, the model takes the maker's)
tolerance.profile: +-15 in z on the centre line, the bonnet's crest line and the deck (the blueprint every 6 px), +-25 where only photographs show it (the lamps' band round the corner, the tail panel)
tolerance.plan: +-20 on the outline after the plan is scaled across to 1780 (see drawingChecks)
tolerance.parts: the lump has no parts: lamps, grille, tail lamps, wing, mirrors are later parts (R3)
